rawContent: After watching both the Fox and FX executive sessions at TCA, definitely have sense that the #MeToo movement has Hollywood fearful of the next shoe drop.
With the Disney-Fox merger and the #MeToo movement all the hot topics, nice to see FX, Fox, ABC, and Showtime willing to be candid about those issues and other current topics at Winter TCA18.

Much more impressed with networks that acknowledge their #MeToo problem, cut out (e.g., fire) the offender(s), and strive to offer and spotlight safe-guards for women to report any instances of sexual harassment or assault.  Goal: admit/remedy/ensure safety.
